description: This file is a shell script (bash/sh) that contains a test suite to validate the behavior of the 'git ls-tree' command with various options and filters. It sets up a Git repository with specific test files and directories, then runs multiple assertions to verify correct output and handling of edge cases related to directory listing in Git.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success; used to specify setup steps and test assertions.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or inputs to verify correctness.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite execution.
